discovered_by: Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh 2020, the periodic product of perfect quaternion sequences with the correspondence of Barrera Acevedo and Dietrich cited there, applied to the Williamson quadruple n3-831d8388ba2174cb0688 of length 3 on this board, whose discovery is credited on its own entry; rows generated by tools/construct_even_williamson.py and stored in canonical form

sources.title: Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh, New infinite families of perfect quaternion sequences and Williamson sequences, IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 66 (2020): Williamson sequences of length 2^t, and the periodic product of a perfect sequence over the quaternion group with a Williamson quadruple of coprime odd length

notes: n = 16 x 3, coprime. The even factor is the Williamson quadruple of length 2^4 of the cited paper; the odd factor is n3-831d8388ba2174cb0688. Each quadruple is read position by position as a quaternion through the correspondence tabulated in the cited paper, the two sequences are multiplied entrywise with indices taken modulo their lengths, and the product is read back as four rows.
